title: Multivariate screening of Brugia spp. adults
author: Nicolas J. Wheeler
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1918/v2

steps.title: Prepare Initial Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare 24-well plates containing 750 μL of complete media (RPMI + 10% FBS + P/S) per well. Warm the media and plates prior to parasite arrival.

steps.title: Acclimatize Parasites
steps.instruction: Place tubes of parasites in a 37°C CO2 incubator for 30-60 minutes to allow them to recover motility.

steps.title: Seed Parasites
steps.instruction: Transfer a single parasite into each well of the prepared 24-well plates. Immediately return the plate to the incubator and record the time.

steps.title: Prepare Drug Treatment Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare new 24-well plates with incomplete media (no FBS).

substeps.instruction: If drug treatments are planned, add 750 μL of media minus the volume of the drug to be added (e.g., add 675 μL for a 10X drug dilution).
Prepare drug stocks at 10X concentration in RPMI and keep them warm.

steps.title: First Parasite Transfer and Recovery
steps.instruction: Approximately 23 hours after the initial seeding time, transfer parasites to the new plates and return them to 37°C to recover for ~1 hour.

steps.title: Collect Initial Conditioned Media
steps.instruction: Process the conditioned media from the first 24-well plates.

substeps.instruction: Transfer conditioned media from females to labeled 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge female tubes for 5 min at 10,000 x g.
Discard 500 μL of the supernatant and store the remaining pellet of mf (~200 μL) at 4°C.
Discard conditioned media from males.

steps.title: Baseline Video Recording
steps.instruction: Immediately prior to adding drugs, video record the entire plate for 15 s at 16 FPS.

steps.title: Administer Drug Treatment
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate to the BSC and add the drug at the desired dilution.

steps.title: Post-Treatment Monitoring
steps.instruction: Monitor parasite response via video recording.

substeps.instruction: Record videos after 1 hour of incubation.
Prepare new 24-well plates with incomplete media + 1X drug and warm at 37°C.
Record videos at the 24 hour mark.

steps.title: Second Parasite Transfer and Recovery
steps.instruction: Transfer parasites to new plates and return them to the incubator. Retain the plates containing conditioned media.

steps.title: Collect Second Conditioned Media
steps.instruction: Process the conditioned media from the second set of plates.

substeps.instruction: Transfer conditioned media from females to labeled 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge female tubes for 5 min at 10,000 x g.
Transfer 500 μL of the supernatant (or conditioned media from males) to a 96-well deep well plate.
Cover the plate with foil sealing film and store at -80°C.
Store the female mf pellet at 4°C and discard remaining male conditioned media.

steps.title: Quantify Microfilariae (mf)
steps.instruction: Analyze the stored mf pellets using imaging software.

substeps.instruction: Pipette to mix mf pellets stored at 4°C and transfer 50 μL to a 96-well plate for ImageXpress.
Image the plate with 4X, tiling a 2x2 grid to cover the entire well; merge images after exportation.
Load images into ImageJ as a stack.
Draw a circle ROI that avoids the well rim.
Manually adjust the histogram percentage to maximize segmented objects and minimize background.
Set measurements to 'area & limit to threshold' under Analyze > Set measurements.
Run Image > Stacks > Measure stack.

description: Image > Adjust > Threshold (dark background, stack histogram) > Apply (unselect everything)
